title: Fixed Triangulated Hemisphere and Annular Foot Frame
description: One newly authored complete open hemispherical triangular-frame architectural display. Short straight thick struts form a continuous spatial triangular network derived from subdivided polyhedral directions and a clipped equator, with independent solid six-sided joint hubs at each meeting point. Every rod end seats inside its hub. A complete lower annular sill and eight finite foot pads carry the full open dome; the interior and every triangle remain genuinely empty, with no filled glass, hidden hemisphere or opaque shelter fabric. Unlike the complete observatory shell and cylindrical-wall radial-rafter yurt, the new whole structure has neither solid roof shell nor separate radial rafters and wall lattice: one triangulated hemispherical graph spans from its basal ring across the crown. No old geometry imported. One static architectural module, zero scenes, three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and ground-centred bounds. Geodesic-inspired artistic framing only, not a certified geometric frequency or engineering design. No construction, weather protection, load, stability, installation, climbability, occupant, accessibility or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.
